name: SIM Technology Group Limited
summary: Established in 1986 and based in Shanghai, People's Republic of China, SIM Technology Group Limited functions as an investment holding enterprise. Its principal activities involve the conception, creation, production, and sale of mobile phones and Internet of Things (IoT) devices, catering to markets in China, Europe, the United States, and other parts of Asia. The company's business is organized into three primary divisions: Handsets and IoT Terminals, Electronics Manufacturing Services, and Property Management. Beyond its core manufacturing, SIM Technology also delivers a suite of services including electronic manufacturing, logistics, procurement agency, administrative support, and finance leasing. Additionally, the group participates in diverse ventures such as supplying goods to vending machines, designing and constructing smart home solutions, trading snacks, developing automated test equipment, and possessing land use rights. Furthermore, it actively develops, leases, and oversees properties.
